articles.explain: Compliance norms are the rules and regulations that investors must follow to operate in a market. By simplifying these rules, SEBI aims to make it easier for international money to enter India, which helps increase liquidity and growth in the stock market.

story.title: SEBI Reviewing FPI Compliance
story.so_far: SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) is the regulator for the securities market in India. FPIs are investors or investment funds that are based outside of India and invest in Indian financial assets like stocks and bonds.

articles.title: Jio IPO surge helps Reliance topple Tata as most valuable conglomerate in India
articles.source: mint - markets
articles.summary: Following a successful market debut, Jio Platforms' valuation jump has made Reliance Group India's most valuable conglomerate, overtaking Tata Group.
articles.explain: A market debut is the first day a company's shares are available for public trading. When a subsidiary (like Jio) performs well, it increases the value of the parent company (Reliance). A conglomerate is a large corporation made up of many different, often unrelated, businesses.

story.title: Jio Platforms Mega IPO
story.so_far: Jio Platforms, a subsidiary of Reliance Industries, recently launched its IPO to raise capital for its transition into a comprehensive AI and cloud technology provider. It is now established as India's largest-ever public offering. The market debut has had a cascading effect on the parent company's total valuation, reshaping the hierarchy of major Indian business conglomerates.

timeline.text: High-profile global institutional investors have committed Rs 2.5 lakh crore in anchor bids ahead of the public issue opening.
The IPO is set to open tomorrow, October 21, with a high grey market premium suggesting strong potential listing gains.
Reliance is reframing Jio's narrative for investors to emphasize its broad technological reach, spanning cloud, AI, and fixed broadband.
Official filings confirm the IPO size as Rs 30,213 crore, establishing it as the largest ever in the Indian market.
The company's IPO successfully attracted anchor bids worth over $25 billion, signaling strong institutional confidence.
The IPO was oversubscribed 3.16 times on its opening day, driven largely by high demand from institutional investors.
The IPO closed with a subscription rate of 22.19 times, and a listing is scheduled for October 28, 2026.
Market expectations suggest a potential listing price of ₹1,369 based on grey market trading activity.
Jio Platforms is scheduled to begin trading on the stock exchange this Wednesday following its record-setting IPO.
Jio's stock debuted at a 21% premium, significantly boosting Reliance Group's total market capitalization to over Rs 28-30 lakh crore.

articles.title: Subros shares surge 10% after securing Rs 1,225 crore HVAC supply order from Maruti Suzuki

articles.summary: Automotive component maker Subros saw its share price jump 10% after winning a long-term supply contract from Maruti Suzuki.

Long-term supply contracts are vital for manufacturing firms as they provide predictable future revenue and confirm the company's status as a preferred vendor for major car manufacturers like Maruti Suzuki.

story.title: Subros Secures Major Maruti Contract

timeline.text: Subros secured a Rs 1,225 crore contract to supply HVAC systems for two Maruti Suzuki vehicle models over a seven-year period.
Subros is also investing in an innovation center in Noida to focus on future automotive thermal technologies.

articles.title: Janus Henderson, Centrifuge launch tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar
articles.source: Cointelegraph.com News
articles.summary: Janus Henderson and Centrifuge have launched a tokenized fund on the Stellar blockchain, allowing non-US investors to gain exposure to the Nasdaq-100 index.
articles.explain: Tokenization involves taking a traditional asset—like a stock index—and representing it as a digital 'token' on a blockchain ledger. This allows for faster transactions and more efficient trading outside of traditional market hours. It matters because it represents a move by institutional finance to bridge traditional stock markets with crypto-based infrastructure.

story.title: Tokenized Financial Assets Growth
story.so_far: Tokenized stocks are digital representations of traditional shares issued on a blockchain, designed to improve settlement speed and accessibility. The industry is currently competing to establish standard platforms for trading these digital assets while navigating international regulatory frameworks.

timeline.text: A major asset manager, Janus Henderson, has introduced a licensed blockchain-based fund tracking the Nasdaq-100 index.
The launch marks a significant milestone as the first licensed fund of its kind to bring Nasdaq-100 exposure on-chain.

articles.title: Google to preview crypto custody security system as AI threats grow
articles.source: CoinDesk: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Crypto News
articles.summary: Google is developing a new security system for crypto custody to protect digital assets against evolving AI-driven cyber threats.
articles.explain: Crypto custody refers to the secure storage of digital assets, usually handled by third-party institutions. Because crypto cannot be easily recovered if stolen, high-level digital security is essential. Google's entry into this space reflects a trend where major tech companies are providing infrastructure to make digital assets safer for institutional investors.

story.title: Google Develops Crypto Security Systems
story.so_far: As institutional adoption of blockchain and digital assets grows, the need for robust security solutions—or 'custody'—has become critical. Traditional security measures are increasingly vulnerable to AI-powered attacks, necessitating more advanced defense mechanisms for holding large amounts of digital currency.

timeline.text: Google is set to preview a security system specifically designed for crypto custody in response to rising AI-based threats.

articles.title: MFs raise stake for 3 straight quarters in 5 mid-cap stocks; shares gain up to 75% YTD
articles.source: Markets-Economic Times
articles.summary: Mutual funds have consistently increased their positions in specific mid-cap stocks over the last nine months, despite mixed price performance.
articles.explain: Market capitalization (cap) is the total dollar value of a company's outstanding shares. Mid-cap companies are generally viewed as riskier than large, established firms but offer higher potential for growth. Institutional investors often 'accumulate' shares over several months to avoid driving the price up too quickly with large, single-day purchases.

story.title: Institutional Mid-Cap Investment Trends
story.so_far: Mutual funds (MFs) in India often track mid-cap companies—those with medium market capitalization—for their growth potential. When institutional investors consistently increase their stakes in a firm, it typically signals long-term confidence in the company's business model, even if the stock price is temporarily volatile.

timeline.text: Data shows mutual funds increased stakes in 39 mid-cap stocks for three consecutive quarters, with some seeing gains of up to 75%.

articles.title: Nearly 90% of large businesses are embracing tokenized cash to speed up payments: DBS
articles.source: CoinDesk: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Crypto News
articles.summary: A DBS report highlights that a vast majority of large corporations are shifting toward tokenized cash to improve payment efficiency.
articles.explain: Tokenized cash is a digital representation of actual currency that moves across a blockchain. It matters because it reduces 'friction'—the time and cost associated with moving money across borders or between different banks. It allows for 24/7 global settlement, unlike traditional systems that often shut down on weekends or holidays.

story.title: Adoption of Tokenized Corporate Payments
story.so_far: Tokenization involves creating a digital, blockchain-based version of an asset or currency. By using these tokens for payments, corporations can bypass traditional banking intermediaries, resulting in near-instant transaction times and lower processing costs.

timeline.text: DBS reports that nearly 90% of large businesses are now adopting tokenized cash solutions for faster financial settlement.

articles.title: Info Edge Q2 Results: Net profit plunges 93% YoY to Rs 334 crore, revenue rises 13%; co declares Rs 3/share interim dividend
articles.source: Markets-Economic Times
articles.summary: Info Edge reported a significant year-on-year drop in net profit for Q2 2026, largely due to one-time financial comparisons.
articles.explain: A year-on-year (YoY) comparison measures performance against the same period in the previous year. A 'net profit plunge' doesn't always mean a failing business; in this case, it was largely caused by an 'exceptional gain' (a one-time windfall) in the previous year's financials, which makes this year's normal performance look worse by comparison.

story.title: Info Edge Q2 Financial Results
story.so_far: Info Edge is a prominent Indian internet company that owns platforms like Naukri (recruitment), 99acres (real estate), and Jeevansathi (matrimony). Investors look at their quarterly results to understand trends in the Indian digital job market and online real estate activity.

timeline.text: Info Edge's net profit fell 93% to Rs 334 crore, though core business segments like recruitment and 99acres saw revenue growth.
